verdict.rationale: Event webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS note-taking app with a public API, so the axis applies. The documented API (OpenAPI spec on openpm) covers only graphs, links, daily-note appends, note creation and users/me, and lists no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The Zapier mention is a third-party connector, not a documented first-party webhook capability, so it earns no credit.
